meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在所选群组搭建一个常驻 wiki 知识库：创建 wiki/ 和 sources/ 文件夹及索引/日志，并在群组设置中写入维护规则。之后它会把收到的每个文件逐个整理成 wiki 页面。
howto.when: 当你说出“add wiki”“wiki”“knowledge base”等关键词，或要求给 NanoClaw 群组添加知识库时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个 PDF 的内容加进 wiki
say.note: Claude 会存入 sources 并生成相应页面。

say.text: 我发的这些文件请逐个读，别一起处理
say.note: 遵循一次只处理一个文件的纪律。

say.text: 给 wiki 做一次健康检查
say.note: 会触发 lint 操作检查 wiki 状态。

howto.what_en: Claude sets up a persistent wiki: creates wiki/ and sources/, adds index/log, and writes maintenance rules to group's CLAUDE.md. Each file you send is then processed one by one into wiki pages (summaries, entities, concepts).
howto.when_en: When you say “add wiki”, “wiki”, “knowledge base”, or ask to add a knowledge base to a NanoClaw group.

say_en.text: Add this PDF's content to the wiki
say_en.note: It stores the file and creates the wiki pages.

say_en.text: Read these files one at a time, not together
Run a health check on the wiki
say_en.note: Triggers a lint pass over the wiki.
